title: Mai shaheed e raah e khuda hu
body:
Mai shaheed e raah e khuda hu
Mai shaheed e raahe khuda hu
<<DIVIDER>>
karam husain ka mujhpar mazeed hojaye
maru jo farsh e aza par to eid hojaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb jazba hai har maa duae karti hai
khuda kare mera baccha shaheed hojaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aai hai ek shaheed ki ye khuld se sadaa
mai.. khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
wajhe hayaat bangai mere liye qaza
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Labbaik ki uth ti thi har ek samt sadaen
khud maut mujhe deti thi jeene ki duaen
<<DIVIDER>>
tazeem ko phir jhuk gai khud meri nigahen
phir murtuza ne mujhko gale se laga liya
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ye dars mujhe apni shahadat se mila hai
shabbir pe marne me hi jeene ka maza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ab taaba qayamat mera ghar karbobala hai
qatra tha apni zaat me darya se jaa mila
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
3. So jaan se qurbaan mili kaisi sa'adat
maujood thi baali pe meri shahe wilayat
<<DIVIDER>>
us dam thi nigahe meri masroof e ziyarat
kab mera dum nikal gaya mujhko nahi pata
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Masoom ke anwaar ka yu bangaya zaer
jaise kisi manzil pe pohoch jae musafir
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaazi se mutahir ne kiya hai mujhe taahir
sab dhul gaye gunaah lahu jab mera baha
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Turbat se andhero ka guzar ho nahi sakta
maujood hai masoom hai mahaul kisa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
matam kabhi hota hai kabhi hota hai girya
mera mazaar sheh ka azakhana bangaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Mai kaise bhula sakta hu ashoor e moharram
zakhmo se badan choor tha aur karb ka aalam
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aagai fitrus ki kahani mujhe us dum
daali nazar husain ne har zakhm bhar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aye dosto ho laakh mukhalif ye zamana
sar apna kabhi zulm ke aage na jhukana
<<DIVIDER>>
9 laakh bhi aajae to tum khauf na khana
meri tarah jo tum ko bhi deni hai ye sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ab meri aizza ke liye hai ye meri baat
jeeta to kaha hoti bhala meri ye auqaat
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khuld me ghar hurr e dilawar ka mere saath
zarre se mujhko shaah ne suraj bana diya
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Paighaam takallum ye zamane ko suna do
rutba jo shaheedo ka hai duniya ko bata do
<<DIVIDER>>
lau shauqe shahadat ki kuch is tarha badha do
jaa deke har husain ka aashiq ye de sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
mai.. khush naseeb hu
haa mai..khush naseeb hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai shaheed e raah e khuda hu..(2)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
